g.text: Why Fermat is fooled by 561 and Miller-Rabin is not
561 = 3 x 11 x 17 is composite, and 560 = 2^4 x 35. Same number, same base 2, two tests, two verdicts.
Fermat looks only at the end
one jump: 2^560 mod 561, nothing in between is looked at
yet 67 is neither 1 nor 560 (= -1): a square root
of 1 that cannot exist modulo a prime
For contrast, an honest chain: the prime 241 = 2^4 x 15 + 1, same base 2
